create_Data_parameter: create a Data parameter with an initial numpy array value and optional lower and upper bounds
create_Scalar_parameter: create a Scalar parameter representing a single float value with optional bounds and mutable sigma
create_Log_parameter: create a Log parameter for positive variables mutated by Gaussian mutation in log-scale with an exponent
set_bounds_on_Data: set bounds on a Data parameter using bouncing, clipping, constraint, arctan, or tanh methods
set_mutation_on_Data: set the mutation sigma and exponent on a Data parameter for logarithmic mutation behavior
